mapper.insert: insert into user_daily_stat (activity_id, component_id, guid, date_mark, total_num, used_num) values ( #{entity.activityId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{entity.componentId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{entity.guid,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{entity.dateMark,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{entity.totalNum,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{entity.usedNum,jdbcType=INTEGER} ) on duplicate key update total_num = total_num, chance_received = 0, used_num = 0;
mapper.select: select activity_id, component_id, guid, date_mark, (total_num - used_num) as remain_num, total_num, used_num, chance_received from user_daily_stat where `activity_id` = #{activityId} and `guid` = #{guid} and `date_mark` = #{dateMark} limit 1
